title: Flipkart Fashion sees fashion festive growth accelerate by 1,500 basis points YoY on premiumisation, Gen Z demand
summary: Flipkart Fashion is witnessing a notable increase in growth attributed to the consumption patterns of Gen Z consumers. The festive shopping trend has been building momentum ahead of Diwali, beginning with Rakhi and Onam. Premiumisation is becoming a significant factor, as customers increasingly prefer higher-priced fashion items. The demand for occasion-led shopping indicates a shift in consumer purchasing behavior, with planning happening well in advance.
